title: Not possible to assemble completely
text: Not possible to assemble completely. Is a beautiful table but I could not assemble it completely. The bottom part could not be assembled because holes are not big enough for the screws provided. Also, one screw was missing and one was lose in the part that was connecting metal to the wood panel.
